title: HostProfile
description:
Host reference data (BRIEF-2.2-c): tRNA gene copy number and abundance, codon usage, tAI weights, ribosome pool parameters, and the estimated translational capacity.

THE `data_completeness` BLOCK IS LOAD-BEARING. It is not documentation - it is the input to the model-tiering decision rules in ADR-0003 (which epistasis window/order to fit) and ADR-0004 (which capacity estimator tier to use). A host with no Ribo-seq and no proteomics is a legal, supported, first-class case that degrades to a documented reduced-capability configuration; see AMD-006.

lineage_taxids.description: Root-to-leaf NCBI taxonomy path. Used verbatim by the nearest-host fallback distance in ADR-0009.

codon_usage.description: Genome-wide or highly-expressed-subset codon usage. `subset` matters: CAI is defined against a highly-expressed reference set, and using the genome-wide table by mistake is a classic silent error.

fraction.description: Share of this codon within its synonymous family.

relative_adaptiveness.description: w_i for CAI: fraction normalized by the family maximum.

gene_copy_number.description: Anticodon -> genomic gene copies. Always available (it is derivable from any annotated genome with tRNAscan-SE), which is why the tier-3 capacity estimator depends only on this.

abundance.description: Measured tRNA abundance where available. Optional; absence pushes capacity estimation down a tier rather than failing.

wobble_rules_id.description: Named codon->anticodon decoding table with efficiency weights, including inosine wobble. Versioned separately because updating it changes every tAI weight and every ledger demand.

tai.description: Derived tRNA adaptation index weights. Stored rather than recomputed so that a published result can be reproduced even if the derivation code changes.

s_values.description: Wobble penalty parameters, keyed by pairing type (e.g. 'G:U', 'I:C').

optimized_against.description: Dataset id if s-values were fit to expression data rather than taken from the literature defaults.

footprint_codons.description: Ribosome footprint in codons (~28-30 nt in bacteria). This is the biophysical anchor for the default epistasis window in ADR-0003.

proteome_reference.description: Absolute proteome abundance, when available. Its presence is the difference between capacity tier 1 and tier 2 in ADR-0004.

capacity.description: Estimated translational capacity, i.e. the threshold theta of the saturating burden penalty.

estimator_tier.description: 1 = fit to measured burden-expression curves; 2 = derived from ribosome count x elongation rate; 3 = relative-to-native-demand normalization. See ADR-0004.

g_max.description: Asymptotic relative growth-rate cost. Bounded because growth rate cannot go below zero; this is what makes the penalty saturating.

data_completeness.description: Machine-readable capability gate. cf-orchestrator reads this to decide which terms are even offerable for this host, and the API surfaces it so a user is never silently given a fabricated objective.

riboseq_mapped_codons.description: Total in-frame A-site assigned codon observations across all tracks. The ADR-0003 tiering thresholds are stated in this unit.

supported_terms.description: Terms this host has enough data to serve. A job requesting a term outside this list is rejected at submission with CF-HOST-003, not silently degraded.
